items.title: Strategic Sourcing Intern
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . TL;DR: This is a 12-week summer 2027 internship on the Tech Sourcing team in Coinbase's Source to Pay (S2P) group, covering software, SaaS, AI, and cloud spend. You'll run analysis projects that turn vendor and renewal data into clear recommendations, and support live sourcing work. The Source to Pay (S2P) team manages Coinbase's full third-party lifecycle, including strategic sourcing, third-party risk management, procurement-to-pay, and travel and expense. We serve as the primary point of contact for vendors across every category, partnering with cross-functional teams to keep processes clear, efficient, and compliant. Tech Sourcing manages non-human-powered spend: software, SaaS contracts, AI, and cloud. This is a hands-on internship where you'll contribute to real operational work that helps Coinbase scale safely and sustainably. What You'll Do Lead a SaaS optimization review: find overlapping tools, spend, renewal dates, and usage, then recommend consolidation or right-sizing. Build renewal readiness briefs for selected upcoming renewals, covering owners, notice deadlines, spend, usage, and open questions. Research vendor pricing: compare pricing models, usage units, commitments, and overage exposure across several usage scenarios. Support live sourcing work, including vendor research, quote comparisons, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Work with the BPO team to find process delays and test practical fixes. Support RFP and RFQ development and proposal evaluation, and keep desktop procedures and internal documentation accurate. Required Skills & Experience Currently pursuing a degree in finance, business, legal studies, or a related analytical field Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, and deliver on commitments Analytical mindset with the ability to dissect problems, analyze data, and make data-driven recommendations Genuine interest in Coinbase's mission and the future of digital assets Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality Pay Transparency Notice: Depending on your work location, the target hourly rate for this position can range as detailed below. Hourly Rate: $40 — $40 USD Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period. Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial . items.title: Member of Data Staff (Data Acceleration)
items.description: Perplexity is AI for people who expect more. This role brings that same standard to how our data team works, with AI at the center of everything we do. We're looking for someone who's been a great data scientist, analytics engineer, or data engineer: the kind of person who knows which metric actually matters, can design an A/B test that answers the real question, has gone deep on a data model because something didn't add up, and has decided that the highest-leverage thing they can do next is build AI systems that fundamentally change how data science gets done. You'll build AI agents and internal systems that can increasingly handle end-to-end analysis workflows: forming hypotheses, writing and running queries, interpreting results, and drafting recommendations with the right evaluation, review, and guardrails. You'll build the retrieval infrastructure and evaluation loops that let AI systems query the warehouse reliably. You'll create workflows that detect, diagnose, and help fix data issues before they become company-wide problems. You'll build the infrastructure that multiplies what a small data team can ship. You'll join a data team that's already using AI across its work. The next step is turning those individual workflows into scalable systems, shared tools, and an AI-native operating model that becomes a benchmark for how modern data teams work. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build AI agents that do data science - not just SQL copilots, but systems that can safely explore data, form hypotheses, run queries, interpret results, and generate actionable recommendations with clear evaluation and human review loops. - Make AI systems query the warehouse reliably - build the retrieval infrastructure and evaluation loops that let agents use our semantic context and metadata accurately. - Accelerate the AI-native data workflow - turn the best existing AI-assisted workflows into repeatable systems, reusable tools, and patterns the whole data team can adopt. - Automate the data lifecycle - build self-healing pipelines, automated dbt model generation and validation, data quality agents, and diagnosis workflows that reduce manual firefighting. - Ship AI-powered experiment analysis - build agents that interpret A/B test results, flag statistical issues, identify likely drivers, and draft ship/no-ship recommendations. - Turn the data team into a product team - build internal data products that stakeholders use every day, replacing ad hoc requests with self-serve AI interfaces. - Own the full lifecycle - identify high-leverage problems, prototype with LLMs, evaluate accuracy, design the UX, ship to production, and monitor quality over time. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years in data science, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role. You've been close enough to real data work to know what should and should not be automated. - Deep SQL and analytics judgment - you can reason through metrics, experiments, data models, and messy warehouse reality without relying on a tool to think for you. - Strong product sense - you understand what stakeholders actually need, what makes a workflow adoptable, and how to turn a prototype into a product people use. - Hands-on LLM experience - you've built with frontier models, agents, RAG systems, evals, or AI-powered workflows and have opinions about where they work and where they fail. - Pipeline and modeling fluency - you've worked with dbt, warehouse schemas, data quality issues, and the practical tradeoffs behind durable data systems. - Builder mentality - you see a manual process and immediately think about how to systematize it. You ship fast, measure quality, and iterate. - Autonomy - this is a new function. You'll help define the roadmap as much as execute it. BONUS - Experience building production AI agents or agent evaluation systems. - Experience with Snowflake, semantic layers, or metadata systems. - Experience building internal tools, Slack bots, CLIs, or developer productivity products that people actually used. - Strong experimentation background, including metric design and statistical interpretation. - Experience with BI tools and the judgment to know what should be automated versus kept human-reviewed. - Early-stage startup experience. WHY THIS ROLE - Set the standard for the industry - Perplexity's data team is already using AI across its work. You'll turn that into something other data teams look to as the benchmark. - Build AI with AI - Perplexity builds AI for people who expect more. You'll bring that same level of ambition to how the company works with data. - Frontier models, day one - you're at an AI company with access to frontier infrastructure and people who deeply understand what's possible. - Massive leverage - the systems you build will multiply the output of every data team member and every stakeholder who needs data. - Direct impact - small team, no layers of approval. Idea to shipped system in days, not quarters.

items.title: Manager, Deployment Lead, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) - Singapore
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development. About the Role As a Manager of our Deployment Leads in APAC, you’ll lead and grow a team of DLs through high-stakes customer deployments, owning technical and business outcomes end to end. You’ll help build the function as you lead it, navigating significant ambiguity to define its scope and ways of working. You’ll partner with FDE, Product, Research, and GTM to balance customer-specific solutions with reusable capabilities and ensure field insights inform product priorities. Drawing on your experience leading complex technical deployments and products, you’ll guide decisions on scope, feasibility, sequencing, and delivery readiness, helping your team make sound tradeoffs and build lasting customer trust. Success will be measured by the impact of your team’s deployments, the growth of your DLs, and how effectively the team and delivery model scale. This role is based in Singapore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. This role will require travel up to 25%. In this role, you will: - Lead and grow a team of DLs delivering production systems with frontier models - Own end-to-end delivery outcomes, from scoping through production, adoption, and handoff - Set direction and build trust across technical teams, GTM, and customer executives - Codify what works into practical playbooks, consistent delivery practices, and product roadmap inputs - Set a high bar for DL performance through hands-on coaching, actionable feedback, and career development - Make staffing decisions, develop future DL leaders, and build a team that scales without unnecessary complexity You might thrive in this role if you: - Bring 8+ years of customer-facing technical delivery or product leadership experience, including 2+ years managing high-performing teams. - Have personally led complex technical deployments from prototype through production, adoption, and handoff. - Have a strong product mindset, ideally with product management experience, and can balance customer-specific needs with reusable solutions. - Thrive in ambiguity and enjoy building new functions: creating structure where little exists, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and adapting as priorities evolve. - Build deep trust across technical teams, Product, Research, GTM, and customer leadership. - Have a strong track record of hiring, coaching, and developing technical, customer-facing talent; elevate team performance through clarity, not process. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. items.title: Social Media Manager, Dicey
items.description: Who we are Magic Eden became one of the fastest companies in history to reach unicorn status, just 9 months after launch. Now we've taken that energy into our next chapter: Dicey, our crypto casino and sportsbook disrupting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets. We build our own tech in-house, and we use blockchain as a payment rail for faster, more secure, more transparent transactions. The role Most iGaming brands sound exactly the same. We're hiring someone to make sure Dicey never does. You'll be the voice of Dicey on social every day, X first. You come up with the ideas, make most of the content yourself, and own the voice, output and growth of our main accounts. You'll report to our Marketing Lead, who sets the strategy, and you'll get full autonomy on how we show up. Think of the coolest person at the party. Everyone wants to talk to them, they always have the line, and they never lose their composure when things get messy. That's the account we want. Basically, an organised degen. What you'll actually do - Run Dicey's main accounts day to day, with X as the priority: posting, replying, trend-jacking and community. - Come up with ideas. Lots of them. Turn launches, wins and world events into moments people share. - Make most of the content yourself: posts, memes, graphics and short-form video. Our creative team backs you up on bigger video production. - React in real time. When the internet moves, we're in it while it's still relevant. - Walk the line: edgy enough to be remembered, never at the expense of the brand. Know when to bite and when to let the FUD die on its own. - Build and run KOL partnerships that amplify what we're pushing through our main accounts. - Work with product on launches and announcements. - Track what's working and turn results into clear, simple reporting. You'll fit if - You're online too much and you know it. You live in internet culture, and you know iGaming Twitter and crypto Twitter are different crowds. - You write posts that are genuinely funny, sharp and on-trend, and you write them fast. - You make your own content. You don't need a designer or an editor to ship a meme, a graphic or a short video. - You know the difference between edgy and cringe, and between bold and brand-damaging. - Drama doesn't scare you. When Dicey gets pulled in, you handle it with precision and make sure we come out on top. - You've worked with KOLs or creators and know how to run a partnership that actually moves numbers. - You're comfortable with the numbers: reach, engagement, traffic, and what to do about them. - You're proactive. You don't need permission to have an idea, and you don't need chasing to deliver it. - You're comfortable working in online casino and sports betting. Nice to have - You're iGaming native. - You can show us posts or campaigns of yours that took off. - You can name the last brand that made you laugh on X. What you get - Full ownership of the voice of a brand that's growing fast. - Room to grow as the team grows. - Competitive compensation. - Remote, global team. The small print - If it goes viral, it was your idea. - If it flops, it was also your idea. Post the next one anyway.

items.title: Senior SAM Analyst
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Senior SAM Analyst on the CX Compliance team within Customer Experience, you’ll investigate complex financial crime activity and help strengthen AI-assisted investigations. You’ll own high-risk casework and apply human judgment to validate investigative outputs, support accurate regulatory reporting, and identify control gaps. Your findings will help Product, Compliance Technology, and ML Engineering improve investigation quality and efficiency while maintaining human oversight. What you’ll do: Own end-to-end anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing (AML/CTF) investigations involving complex alerts, referrals, fraud typologies, and interconnected customer activity, including open-source research, identity verification, prior filing reviews, and blockchain analysis where needed. Draft and review investigative narratives and Suspicious Activity Reports/Transactions Reports (SARs/STRs), ensuring conclusions are evidence-based, clearly documented, and consistent with applicable requirements. Evaluate AI-generated narratives, evidence, risk assessments, and recommended dispositions using human-in-the-loop (HITL) quality scorecards to capture missed risk indicators, unsupported or fabricated facts, incorrect risk weighting, and inappropriate escalation decisions. Translate recurring investigation, model, data, and workflow defects into actionable feedback for Product, Compliance Technology, and ML Engineering. Support AI evaluation and release testing through annotation, calibration, user acceptance testing, and curated benchmark case reviews that inform model tuning and launch-readiness assessments. Escalate material issues affecting customers, regulatory filings, control effectiveness, or launch readiness, documenting evidence, potential impact, and recommended next steps. Required Skills and Experience: 4+ years of experience in AML, transaction monitoring, fraud investigations, or financial crime compliance, including independent ownership of complex, high-risk, or multi-entity cases. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Demonstrated experience drafting and reviewing SARs/STRs and defending investigative conclusions through documented evidence and applicable regulatory requirements. Experience conducting quality reviews, second-reviewer checks, calibration, user acceptance testing, or model evaluation, including identifying systemic weaknesses and communicating reproducible, actionable findings. Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing cases and make risk-based escalation decisions under ambiguity or time pressure. Preferred: CAMS or another relevant AML, fraud, or crypto investigation certification; experience with SQL, Snowflake, fraud-ring analysis, entity resolution, or blockchain analytics. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Pay Transparency Notice: The target annual base salary for this position can range as detailed below. Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility and benefits (including medical, dental, and vision). Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus): £55,620 — £61,800 GBP Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period. Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. US Applicants: View Employee Rights , Know Your Rights , and E-Verify Notice of Participation. items.title: Managing Editor
items.location_text: United States, Seattle, New York, California, Toronto
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Role summary: The Managing Editor runs the operational engine of the editorial team. This role turns strategy and drafts into a functioning production pipeline across all content streams (thought leadership, developer content, customer stories, product marketing content, etc.). This person is most responsible for whether things ship on time and at a consistent bar. Core responsibilities: - In conjunction with Editorial Content Director, own and maintain the master editorial calendar across all content streams, sequencing work so there is no competition for the same limited writing capacity - Manage the brief-to-publish workflow: assigning work, setting deadlines, tracking status, unblocking bottlenecks - Own the review/approval routing for each content type: legal and PR for thought leadership, engineering/DevRel sign-off for developer content, customer and legal approval for customer stories, product marketing alignment for product content - Set and enforce production-level style and quality standards (distinct from the Content Strategist's audience/strategy standards) - Manage relationships with freelancers, contractors, and cross-functional SME contributors who feed content into the pipeline - Report to the Head of Editorial Content on throughput, capacity, and delivery risk - Own and manage the 24-hour review in the blog tracker - Run competitive and content-gap analysis to identify where the team's limited capacity should go - Ensures style guide story alignment (with Content Editor contributing) - Present editorial performance metrics to cross-functional stakeholders in conjunction with Editorial Director - Partner with Growth Marketing on content positioning alignment - Work with MarOps on attribution and any potential pipeline content Qualifications - 8+ years of experience in editorial or content operations - Experience running multi-stream or multi-format editorial pipelines (not just a single blog) FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. items.title: UX Researcher
items.description: Kick-start your career in the online gaming world and experience the very latest in technology and innovation. Who we are We’re Super Group, the NYSE-listed digital gaming company behind some of the world’s leading Sports and iGaming brands, including Betway and Jackpot City. We’re a powerhouse built on decades of expertise and we’re changing the game for good. Our mission is to give our customers a superclass entertainment experience. Who we’re looking for We’re on a thrilling journey of growth and innovation, and we need passionate, driven individuals to join us. At Super Group International, every day is action-packed, and we expect you to bring your A-game. In return, you’ll find a supportive environment where your skills can flourish and your career can soar. Ready to become a game-changer? Supercharge your career with us and be part of something extraordinary. Why we need you We’re building experiences that wow our customers – and that starts with bold, curious people who want to do work that matters. If you’re hungry to grow, excited by impact and ready for a challenge that will supercharge your career, this could be your moment. This is a mid-level role. User Researchers are dedicated to understanding the needs, behaviours and preferences of customers to inform the design and development of our products across all our remits: sports betting, casino and the platform they share. Your primary focus will be on generating actionable insights from your research to improve the user experience and drive the business forward. User Researchers play a crucial role in ensuring that the design and development align with user needs and expectations. Your work will inform decisions, reduce design guesswork, and ultimately lead to better products for our customers. What you’ll do You’ll take ownership of work that gives us our competitive edge, including: Project and Strategic Research: Run research on specific projects and features, and contribute research that helps shape the longer-term vision for design, product and the business, from opportunity areas to roadmap priorities. Customer-Centric Metrics: Establish and maintain metrics such as Net Promoter Score (NPS) and Customer Effort Score (CES) to measure customer satisfaction and loyalty. User Interviews: Conduct one-on-one interviews with users to gain in-depth insights into their goals, pain points, and expectations. Surveys and Questionnaires: Create surveys and questionnaires to gather quantitative data and feedback from a larger user base. Persona Development: Develop user personas based on research findings to guide design and development strategies. Observation and Usability Testing: Observe users in both controlled environments and real-world scenarios, conducting usability tests to uncover issues and opportunities for improvement. Product & Feature Research: Conduct research on current features and products across our remits to understand what creates the most value for our players. Insight Generation: Analyze and synthesize research data to produce meaningful insights, informing product roadmaps and strategy. Research Operations: Recruit and manage participants, handle consent, recordings and data in line with our privacy obligations, and keep findings findable in a shared research repository. Supporting the Team: Help designers and product managers plan and run their own studies, so research scales across the team. Collaboration with Teams: Work closely with designers, product managers, and developers to integrate user research into the product development process from concept to launch. Feedback Loops: Establish continuous feedback loops through player interviews, customer support collaboration, and in-product surveys to maintain up-to-date insights. Competitive Analysis: Research competitors’ products to identify trends and areas for differentiation, helping the business stay competitive in the market. Presenting Insights: Regularly present research findings and actionable recommendations to cross-functional teams. This list covers your core responsibilities – with plenty of room to stretch, explore and take on new challenges as we grow. Research Tools Proficiency: Proficient in UserTesting, Fullstory, Tableau and Figma. Along with the below behavioural competencies, these are essential for all employees in order for you to embed in and drive our culture forward. These competencies are: Adaptability Ownership and accountability Initiating action Resilience Team orientation Integrity Innovation What you’ll get back We invest in your growth and wellbeing, so you can bring your best: Supergrowth is real here. We’re honest, fair, and focused on helping you succeed – and your work will have real impact from day one. items.title: Applied AI Architect, Cyber
items.description: About the Team The Applied AI Architecture team is responsible for helping developers and enterprises safely and effectively deploy OpenAI technologies in production. We act as trusted technical advisors and thought partners for customers, working side by side with their teams to identify high-value use cases, design practical architectures, and move from prototype to durable deployment. Cybersecurity is one of the most urgent domains where AI can help. Security teams are under pressure to reason across code, logs, infrastructure, tickets, alerts, and vulnerability data faster than ever. As frontier models become more capable, organizations need deep technical guidance on how to evaluate, validate, and safely deploy AI systems in security-critical workflows. About the Role We are looking for a Cybersecurity Applied AI Architect to partner with customers and help them apply OpenAI models, APIs, Codex, and agentic workflows to real cybersecurity use cases. You will work with CISOs, security executives, application security leaders, SOC teams, security engineering teams, and hands-on practitioners to identify where AI can create measurable security outcomes. This is a customer-facing technical role for someone who can move fluidly between executive strategy, practitioner-level cyber depth, and hands-on solution design. You will help customers evaluate and deploy workflows such as secure code review, vulnerability triage, threat modeling, remediation, SOC and incident response workflows, detection engineering, cloud security, GRC automation, and security validation. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Research, and Security to turn customer needs into safe deployment patterns, reusable field assets, and product feedback. In this role, you will: - Deeply embed with strategic customers as the technical lead for AI-enabled cybersecurity workflows, serving as a trusted partner to both security executives and technical practitioners. - Lead discovery across AppSec, DevSecOps, vulnerability management, SOC/IR, detection engineering, red team, cloud security, identity, and GRC automation use cases. - Build and deliver customer-facing demos, prototypes, workshops, proofs of concept, and reference architectures using OpenAI APIs, Codex, agents, scripts, CLIs, GitHub workflows, CI/CD systems, logs, tickets, scanners, and common security tools. - Scope pilots with clear success criteria, data requirements, workflow integrations, evaluation methods, security constraints, safety boundaries, and human approval points. - Advise customers on safe implementation patterns, including tool and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval, sandboxing, data handling, guardrails, telemetry, auditability, and approval-gated side effects. - Translate between CISO-level outcomes and practitioner-level implementation details so each audience understands value, risk, and practical next steps. - Create reusable field assets such as demo narratives, playbooks, FAQs, objection handling, qualification guides, assessment templates, and competitive positioning. - Validate, synthesize, and deliver high-signal feedback to Product, Engineering, Research, Security, and GTM teams based on recurring customer requirements, blockers, product gaps, and emerging cyber workflows. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 5+ years of technical consulting, solutions engineering, security architecture, cyber advisory, deployment engineering, professional services, or equivalent customer-facing technical experience. - Bring strong cybersecurity domain expertise across one or more areas such as application security, cloud security, identity, vulnerability management, secure SDLC, incident response, detection engineering, threat intelligence, red teaming, or security architecture. - Can communicate credibly with CISOs, CTOs, security executives, engineering leaders, and highly technical security practitioners. - Have hands-on experience building prototypes or production systems with APIs, Python or JavaScript, agents, scripts, CLIs, GitHub workflows, CI/CD systems, logs, tickets, scanners, or other common security tooling. - Understand how to design AI workflows with retrieval, structured outputs, tool use, evals, guardrails, telemetry, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop review. - Are comfortable scoping pilots from ambiguous customer pain, including success metrics, required data, workflow integrations, evaluation criteria, deployment assumptions, and decision gates. - Have evidence-first security judgment: you validate findings, separate true positives from noise, document assumptions, and avoid overstating model or security claims. - Own problems end-to-end, operate with high throughput across multiple concurrent customer projects, and know when to stay hands-on versus create reusable leverage for the broader field. - Have a humble attitude, an eagerness to help colleagues, and a desire to do whatever it takes to make the team and our customers successful. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

items.title: Engineering Manager, Agent Security Partnerships
items.location_text: New York City, NY | Seattle, WA; San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About Anthropic Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Agent Security's mission is to safely increase how much of the world's work agents can do, starting inside Anthropic. Claude now writes and ships code, runs experiments and acts on people's behalf, for hours at a time. How much more it can take on depends on how safely it can operate. If, in the worst case, an agent misbehaves, Anthropic and the public may bear the consequences. Our mandate is to mitigate this risk, and Anthropic’s mission depends on it. The Partnerships team pairs security engineers with the teams at Anthropic that build Claude, build agents and rely on agents. Those teams are our partners. When a team wants its agents to do more, we threat model the plan with them and build the controls together. Most of this has no playbook, so we have often created new controls from first principles. The ones that work become part of our toolbox, spread to other teams, and in some cases ship in our products. We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead this team of security engineers. This is first and foremost a people leadership role. Few have secured agents at scale, especially at a frontier lab, so we don't expect you to have done it. We do expect you to have led security engineering teams, and we care most about how you lead people and reason about security. This role operates at the frontier. Each model generation, and each new harness, brings new challenges. The number of teams building on agents keeps growing, and partner teams won't always agree with your calls. In return, you will have the chance to directly contribute to making transformative AI go well, which is the heart of our mission. Key responsibilities Hire, mentor and grow senior and staff security engineers, and raise the bar as the team scales Set the team's investment strategy, deciding which teams get embedded engineers, and for how long, as demand outgrows the team Support the team through high-stakes safety and security calls made under uncertainty and on tight timelines Balance long-term investment in shared controls against partner teams’ immediate asks Deliver large security migrations across all of Anthropic Work through difficult tradeoffs with partner teams in ways that build trust and understanding Representative Projects In the past, the team has: Invented a new kind of classifier-based control for agents partnering with an internal team to develop and roll it out Co-built a sandbox with a product team, choosing what to enforce first so that adoption stuck Defined the security standards for running agents across the company and partnered with many different teams on how to hit these standards Minimum qualifications Excellent people management skills. You've hired, developed and managed senior and staff engineers, grown engineers into staff or lead roles, and kept a team delivering through changing priorities. Deep security management experience. You've managed security engineering teams and answered to executives for risk and tradeoffs. Strong written and oral communication skills. You've explained hard tradeoffs to executives and to engineers in plain words. Resilience, emotional awareness, low ego and high empathy Experience leading large migrations and highly cross-functional work A willingness to dive into the details to tie-break complex trade-offs without any clear answer, and the ability to stand by these decisions Preferred qualifications Experience embedding security engineers with product, infrastructure or research teams, or running a security partnerships team Agent security or AI/ML security experience Familiarity with AI safety concepts and research Leading in hypergrowth The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Launch Producer, Business Marketing
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM Business Marketing helps knowledge workers, developers, and business decision-makers understand and adopt OpenAI’s products, supporting both self-serve growth and our managed sales team. Our creative work makes complex capabilities clear, grounded, and human as they move from the lab into businesses and everyday work. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a hands-on Launch Producer to build and run a repeatable, scalable creative production engine for Business Marketing launches, spanning new models, products, and capabilities, as well as solutions and use cases. You’ll help shape the right creative and video approach for each launch, then lead production from brief through delivery. Most launches center on owned and social channels, and leverage video as a primary medium to explain new products and capabilities. Our largest launches also shape broader brand marketing, requiring coordination with Integrated Marketing and Media. This role combines building the system with running the work. You should be equally comfortable improving a workflow, leading a shoot, and partnering with a motion designer. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Lead launch intake and planning, aligning creative scope, resources, and timelines with launch priorities. - Partner with Product Marketing, Integrated Marketing, creative leads, and subject-matter experts to translate launch goals, audiences, messaging, and technical capabilities into compelling briefs, scripts, demos, and customer stories. - Produce videos at varying levels of fidelity, including demos, motion graphics, sizzle videos, explainers, and talking-head or testimonial videos featuring OpenAI talent and customers. - Lead production end to end: budgets, schedules, resourcing, shoots, post-production, and delivery. Consolidate feedback and approvals, manage dependencies, and surface risks and decisions early so assets are ready to ship. - Partner with Creative Operations to assemble and manage the right production team for each launch, drawing on your trusted bench of freelancers, agencies, and production partners alongside internal talent. Set clear scopes, expectations, and quality standards. - Plan assets for owned and social distribution, including formats, cutdowns, and channel-specific adaptations. Coordinate usage rights, accessibility, quality control, and final delivery requirements with the relevant partners. - Partner with Demand teams to translate launch strategy into demand-generation creative, informing briefs, asset needs, and cutdowns while those teams own demand execution. - Coordinate with Integrated Marketing and Media on major launches with broader brand and paid-media implications. - Build reusable workflows, templates, and production approaches. Use AI-enabled tools, post-launch learnings, and asset performance to improve speed, quality, and effectiveness without adding unnecessary process. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE - 12+ years in integrated creative production, digital production, program management, or a related field, with a proven track record of managing complex creative initiatives. - A true operator’s mindset: you can build a reliable production system and keep multiple launches moving through it. - Strong storytelling and creative judgment, with hands-on experience leading video shoots and working with motion designers, editors, and other production specialists. - An established network of creative and production talent, and sound judgment about the right team, scope, and approach for each brief, budget, and timeline. - Fluency in post-production and delivering assets across social, owned, and demand channels. - Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative working style. You build trust across disciplines, make tradeoffs visible, and keep teams aligned through shifting priorities. - A scrappy, resourceful approach and comfort with ambiguity and tight timelines. You know when a simple demo is enough and when a launch needs a more ambitious treatment. - A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end production leadership across fast-turn and larger-scale work, with your specific contribution and outcomes clearly identified. Work Location: San Francisco About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Product Manager in the Internal Products and Technologies organization, you'll own the experiences our sales teams use to configure, price, quote, approve, and close deals. You’ll partner with Engineering, Sales, Deal Operations, Finance, and Legal to shape how customers buy from Anthropic. You’ll balance a fast, simple seller experience with rigorous governance. Responsibilities Deeply understand sellers, Deal Desk, Legal, and Order Management workflows and how tooling can improve their impact. Own product strategy and roadmap for quoting, approvals, and deal execution, using AI wherever it makes the experience meaningfully better. Partner with engineering to design and ship the systems behind quoting, pricing, and approvals, and own adoption as well as launch. Make prioritization calls across competing stakeholder needs. You might be a good fit if you have 8+ years in product management, including ownership of complex internal or enterprise products. Experience building or scaling CPQ (configure, price, quote), pricing, or approval systems for complex enterprise deals. Experience shipping AI-powered workflows that people relied on in production. Experience with products where financial controls and auditability matter. A record of resolving conflicting priorities across functions without direct authority. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $305,000 — $385,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Senior Product Manager, Simple Trading
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Senior Product Manager on the Simple Trading team within the Consumer & Business group, you'll own core parts of the retail trading experience used by millions of customers every day. This team builds delightful user experiences and UIs that optimize the primary buy, sell, and convert flows that drive Coinbase's consumer trading business. You'll define the product vision for your area, ship high-impact improvements across web and mobile, and partner closely with Engineering, Design, and Data Science to make crypto and perpetuals/derivatives trading engaging, delightful, and more trustworthy for every user. What you'll do: Own the end-to-end product roadmap for your area of the Simple Trading experience, from discovery and definition of engaging user experiences through execution, launch, and iteration across web and mobile UIs and platforms. Drive measurable improvements in trading conversion, user engagement, and revenue by identifying friction points, running experiments, and shipping data-informed solutions at scale. Partner with Engineering, Design, and Data Science to deliver high-quality consumer trading experiences, balancing speed, reliability, and usability across core trading workflows. Shape the long-term product strategy for retail trading by synthesizing user research, market trends, regulatory requirements, and competitive dynamics into a clear, prioritized vision. Lead cross-functional alignment across Consumer Trade and partner teams, ensuring stakeholders across Tax, Legal, Compliance, and Finance are informed and engaged on key decisions. Required Skills and Experience: 5+ years of Product Management experience shipping UI-heavy consumer products at scale, including at least 2 years working on trading, fintech, or marketplace products where conversion and revenue metrics were primary success measures. Deep familiarity with retail trading products, order types, and user workflows, with the ability to articulate what makes a trading experience intuitive and trustworthy. Proven ability to define and execute a product roadmap in high-ambiguity environments, with demonstrated results in improving core user flows visited by millions of users. Deep expertise in experimentation methodology, including designing A/B tests, defining success metrics, and interpreting results to inform product decisions with minimal analyst support. Fluency with data tools (SQL, Amplitude, or similar) sufficient to self-serve analyses, build dashboards, and monitor product health independently. Track record of driving alignment across senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, translating complex trade-offs into clear recommendations that accelerate decision-making. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Bitnomial is building the next generation US-based global derivatives exchange, starting with digital assets and progressively expanding to encompass a full spectrum of commodities worldwide. Bitnomial operates a US CFTC regulated exchange (DCM), clearinghouse (DCO), and brokerage (FCM). It offers a range of crypto-settled derivatives, including futures, options, and a suite of live perpetual futures, used by brokers, hedge funds, institutions, and trading firms around the world. Bitnomial's exchange, clearinghouse, and brokerage systems are written largely in Haskell. In this role you will build the services and data models that record every order, fill, and settlement at a CFTC-regulated exchange and clearinghouse, with the database as a first-class part of the design. You will build features across these systems and design the schema, queries, and migrations behind them. THE OPPORTUNITY - Improve build and release pipelines in GitHub Actions: caching, parallelism, pinned toolchains, and required tests and scans before production - Manage AWS infrastructure as code with Terraform, and run services as containers on Nomad - Build deployment tooling with health checks and automated rollback, and make deploys safe around market sessions - Add metrics and alerts to the services you build, so you can see whether a deploy worked - Monitor systems, respond to alerts, and support daily operations such as settlement cycles - Fix the cause of production issues and write down what you learned - Build, test, and ship well-reviewed features and fixes in our services across the exchange, clearinghouse, and brokerage. Most of the code is Haskell - Understand the order, trade, clearing, and settlement flows end to end WHAT YOU BRING - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI - Production experience with AWS and Docker, and infrastructure as code with Terraform - Strong Linux and scripting skills (Bash, Python, or similar) - 3+ years of professional software engineering experience with a functional or strongly typed programming language such as Haskell, Rust, or C++ - Solid computer science fundamentals, including distributed systems: failure modes, retries and idempotency, consistency, and how to observe them across services - Willingness to take part in on-call and operational shifts - Care and rigor with code that moves money - Good judgment with AI tools. You use them to work faster, and you read, test, and understand what they produce before you ship it - A habit of asking why before changing something - Sound judgment under pressure, with a calm and methodical approach when production is live - Collaboration across engineering, operations, risk, and compliance, with a habit of documenting NICE TO HAVES - Financial knowledge or experience in trading, markets, or financial services - Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience - Experience with Nomad or Kubernetes - Experience with Nix, Ansible, Vault, or Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki - Haskell experience Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. items.title: GTM Enablement - Product
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We’re hiring our first Product Enablement specialist. You will join the Product & Technical Enablement team and help our go-to-market teams get ready for every product launch, across Agents, APIs, and Creative. You will support our global go-to-market teams. Your mission: help sellers understand, demo, and sell each new launch with confidence, with preparation that starts well before launch day. What sets this role apart: we’re looking for someone who knows our products well enough to demo them and sell them. You have used agents, APIs, or creative tools hands-on, and you can explain how they work and why they matter to customers. You blend that with sales, solutions engineering, or product marketing experience, so you can teach sellers how to use a product, how to demo it, and how to pitch it. This role sits within GTM Enablement and reports to the Product & Technical Enablement Lead. You will work in close partnership with: - Product marketing and engineering teams (keeping content accurate as the platform ships) - GTM enablement (aligning on shared onboarding infrastructure) You will support product enablement for our go-to-market teams across Agents, APIs, and Creative, with the most day-to-day focus on API and Creative launches. This is a full-stack role on a lean team: you’ll build content, deliver training, design practice environments, and flex across products as needed. What you’ll do - Support new product launches: get an early heads-up from product marketing, research, and engineering, follow releases from alpha through GA, and have training ready before launch day, not the week of - Build launch workshops: go beyond what shipped and why it matters, with hands-on workshops on how to use the product, how to demo it, and how to pitch the value - Support competitive enablement: turn product marketing battlecards into trainings, simulations, and demo workshops, so sellers can answer parity, differentiation, and value questions with confidence - Support product certification: help define what “product certified” means for GTM teams, and build the playbooks and training content that raise product confidence across the whole field, not only new hires - Support everboarding and onboarding: keep training tied to new releases and capabilities, and keep content current as products ship - Craft realistic practice environments: demo certifications, role-play scenarios, and customer simulations with scored feedback, built on our own agent technology - Operate AI-natively: use ElevenLabs’ own voice and agent technology to build training and practice environments; default to AI tools to build faster, and teach others to do the same - Measure what matters: define and track the percent of sellers certified within 2 weeks of GA, demo and pitch quality scores, and win rate and stage progression against named competitors, and use the data to improve each launch Requirements We’re looking for someone who knows our products well and can teach sellers to demo and sell them. You’ll thrive here if you: - Have 4-7+ years as an enterprise seller or solutions engineer, or as a seller who moved into product marketing or enablement, at a SaaS, platform, or API-first company - Are hands-on with agents, APIs, or creative tools, and understand at a conceptual level how they work - Have demoed and pitched technical products to customers, and can explain the value, not only the features - Have a track record of teaching, mentoring, or building training, in addition to your customer-facing work - Are comfortable building a program from scratch, with no playbook to inherit - Have credibility with sellers, built from time in the seat or supporting sellers directly, and work well with product marketing, research, and engineering teams - Communicate clearly and can adapt product material for different audiences without diluting it Bonus - Experience at a high-growth AI/ML, developer tools, or API-first company - Background in voice AI, conversational AI, or contact center technology - Vertical depth in financial services, healthcare, telecom or CCaaS, or at other AI companies - Hands-on experience with competing voice and agent platforms - Experience running workshops or labs for sellers or customers - Experience building role-play, simulation, or demo practice environments Location Remote-first, globally distributed role. Expect occasional travel to team hubs and onboarding sessions. Candidates should be able to work effectively across US and European time zones. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Incident Commander, Detection & Response - US
items.description: About the Team Security is at the foundation of OpenAI’s mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Security team protects OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We are technical in what we build but are operational in how we do our work, and are committed to supporting all products and research at OpenAI. Our Security team tenets include: prioritizing for impact, enabling researchers, preparing for future transformative technologies, and engaging a robust security culture. About the Role As an Incident Commander on Detection & Response, you’ll lead the response to complex security incidents affecting OpenAI’s intellectual property, customer data, and infrastructure. You’ll establish response priorities, coordinate technical work streams, drive containment and recovery decisions within agreed authority, and keep stakeholders informed as facts evolve. You’ll work with security and infrastructure teams across endpoints, identity, cloud, and compute environments, maintaining clear ownership and effective handoffs across time zones. Detection engineering knowledge is a supporting requirement: you’ll use telemetry and detection logic to assess evidence, identify visibility gaps, and guide improvements that make incident response more effective. In this role, you will: - Run incident command from initial assessment through containment, recovery, and closure, establishing severity, scope, response objectives, and escalation needs. - Assign work stream owners and coordinate investigation, containment, and recovery in parallel. Maintain a decision log and distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions. - Drive timely containment and recovery decisions with the appropriate owners, weighing security risk, evidence preservation, and operational impact within agreed decision rights. - Communicate incident status, impact, uncertainty, actions underway, and the next update to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. - Manage cross-time-zone handoffs with explicit command ownership, current status, outstanding risks, pending decisions, and next actions. - Improve response readiness through exercises, playbooks, and post-incident reviews; track agreed corrective actions with their owners. - Partner with detection engineers to evaluate telemetry and detection quality, close incident-related visibility gaps, and prioritize practical response automation. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have personally led complex security incidents as incident commander or an equivalent response lead, with clear examples of decisions, delegation, escalation, and outcomes. - Make sound decisions with incomplete information and revise them as evidence changes, balancing containment urgency with operational impact. - Coordinate responders across teams and time zones, resolve conflicting priorities, and maintain clear ownership during handoffs. - Communicate calmly and precisely under pressure, including concise stakeholder updates and explicit statements of uncertainty. - Have the security and infrastructure fundamentals to challenge investigation findings and assess containment and recovery options. - Understand detection engineering, including telemetry coverage, detection logic, false positives and false negatives, and validation. Can query and interpret evidence to support response decisions. - Turn incident lessons into practical improvements to readiness, playbooks, detection coverage, and response tooling.
